claims.text: The resignation Spec names @Kent as its flow owner: 「流程 Owner：Kent」.
Felix's comment c49317 (2026-09-03) set the interim path:
「目前人工经通道二提交的方式会保留为建设期的过渡方案」.
claims.quote: 目前人工经通道二提交的方式会保留为建设期的过渡方案

claims.text: The manager submission channel accepts a submission only from the employee's direct supervisor: 「提交人须为离职员工的直属上级」.
claims.quote: 提交人须为离职员工的直属上级

claims.text: Any other submitter is stopped and no case is created: 「阻止提交、不生成主单」.
In this flow's target design the system itself opens the resignation case: 「系统自动在「员工离职Spec」建立一张离职主单」.
claims.quote: 系统自动在「员工离职Spec」建立一张离职主单

claims.text: People only fill in the remaining details afterwards: 「离职单已自动建立，通知其在规定时限内补齐最后工作日等信息」.
claims.quote: 离职单已自动建立，通知其在规定时限内补齐最后工作日等信息

claims.text: Those details come from the direct supervisor, or from HR Ops & Data when the supervisor is absent: 「缺位由HR Ops & Data代为补充」.
claims.quote: 缺位由HR Ops & Data代为补充

claims.text: During the interim manual path, who submits the resignation case when the supervisor is absent, given 「缺位由HR Ops & Data代为补充」?

claims.text: This flow's Spec already routes the case to HR Ops & Data at submission: 「缺位由 HR Ops & Data 代为受理提交」.

claims.text: The shared supervisor lookup only reports reporting-line facts and leaves the decision to each flow: 「只回答汇报线事实，不做资格判定」.
